properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 817721 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 817721
Incident Time: 2006-10-23 11:18:00
Nearest City: Honolulu, HI
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: PETROLUEM
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 3.28 feet by 49.21 feet (area 161.46 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 15 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
*WEB REPORT*AFTER THE END OF HAULING SET EIGHT I WAS ON DECK AND NOTICED THE PROFUSE SMELL OF PETROLEUM (I.E. GASOLINE SMELL). THE VESSEL WAS ADRIFT AFTER THE END OF THE EIGHTH SET AT THE TIME OF THIS INCIDENT. THE CAPTAIN WAS PUMPING OUT THE BILGE IN THE ENGINE ROOM WHICH WAS FULL OF OIL AND PETROL. I NOTICED THE SMELL AND A PETROLEUM SHEEN IN THE WATER ON THE REAR PORT QUARTER OF THE BOAT. THE SHEEN SEEMED TO COVER AN AREA OF ABOUT 15 SQUARE METERS. THE SHEEN WAS 1 METER WIDE ALONG THE EDGE OF THE BOAT EXTENDING 15 METERS DOWN THE SIDE OF THE BOAT, THE REST WAS BEYOND THE REACH OF THE LIGHTS AND WAS NOT VISIBLE. I ASKED THE CAPTAIN WHERE IT WAS COMING FROM AND HE TOLD ME THAT IT WAS FROM PUMPING OUT THE BILGE IN THE ENGINE ROOM. DURING THE COURSE OF THE TRIP I FREQUENTLY SHOWERED IN THE ENGINE ROOM AND THE SHOWER RUN OFF ACCUMULATED IN THE BILGE UNDER THE ENGINE WHICH WAS FULL OF OIL AND PETROL (BILGE DEPTH OF A FOOT OR SO AT TIMES). PERIODOCALLY, AS IS THE CASE WITH THIS INCIDENT, THE BILGE LEVEL WOULD BE REDUCED TO NEAR ZERO HEIGHT INDICATING THAT THIS PETROLEUM AND WATER MIXTURE WAS PUMPED OUT OF THE BOAT.
